units.rawText: Are you okay? Erika lured those monsters away, she asked me to help you out first.

spans.text: Are you okay? Erika lured those monsters away, she asked me to help you out first.

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, we're not doing well. Most of us are hurt and everyone else is having a hard time keeping up the defense.
